name: Sassenberg (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, yellow and red in the proportions 1:3:1, charged at the centre with the city arms of Sassenberg (three yellow swords above a mount on red).
history: Municipal flag of Sassenberg; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Sassenberg arms — three swords on red
